vocabulary.zh: n. 数百万

n the number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros

cloze.title: 四选一完形填空

parts.text:
Why the heart struggles to repair itself

A heart attack (myocardial infarction) occurs when blood flow through a coronary

is significantly reduced or even fully blocked. Without oxygen, the cells of the heart muscle begin to die. These specialised cells, called cardiomyocytes, are responsible for the continuous contractions of the heart muscle, which pumps blood around the body to our

organs.

Unlike skin or liver tissue, the adult human heart has limited capacity to replace damaged cells. Instead, dead muscle is largely replaced by fibrous scar tissue. Although this scar helps maintain the heart’s structural

, it cannot contract like healthy muscle.

The consequence is a heart that may become progressively weaker, sometimes leading to heart failure.

Modern treatments, such as procedures to reopen blocked arteries, medication and supervised

programmes, have greatly improved survival. But they cannot replace heart muscle that has already died.

During the early development of the heart, the cardiomyocytes divide, allowing the heart muscle to grow. Shortly after birth, most

cardiomyocytes largely lose this ability. The researchers investigated whether they could restart this process by making heart muscle cells produce two proteins, called Myc and cyclin T1.

Myc switches on genes involved in cell growth and division, while cyclin T1 helps

the machinery cells need to multiply. Together, the proteins can encourage mature heart muscle cells to start dividing again.

The researchers used modified mRNA to give heart muscle cells

for making the two proteins. This is the same basic technology used in COVID vaccines, which deliver temporary genetic instructions to cells to make a protein that trains the immune system to recognise the virus.

Importantly, mRNA does not need to

a cell’s DNA. Instead, it provides temporary instructions that are naturally broken down. This temporary activity is particularly important when stimulating cell growth because uncontrolled cell growth is the basis of cancer.

What happened in the damaged hearts?

The researchers tested their approach in mice following

induced heart attacks.

The researchers injected the modified mRNA directly into the damaged hearts of mice that had suffered heart attacks. The treatment activated genes involved in cell division,
heart muscle cells to start multiplying. Crucially, the treated mice also showed improvements in heart function.

reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: New research explores a way to repair heart tissue damaged by a heart attack.
Managing blood sugar requires understanding which strategies actually reduce glucose spikes.
Research compares heat and cold as approaches to recovery after exercise.
Blood changes may provide clues to very early processes associated with ovarian cancer.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: If future studies demonstrate that the approach is both safe and effective in humans, treating a heart attack might one day involve not only restoring blood flow, but also giving the heart the instructions it needs to repair itself.

questions.prompt: How should the heart-repair finding be interpreted at present?
options: As early research suggesting a possible future route to regeneration
As evidence that adult heart damage needs no medical attention
As a guarantee that every damaged heart will recover unaided
As proof that a cure is already routinely available to everyone
questions.explanation: 第 4 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: Although this is still early-stage research, the study offers the tantalising possibility that one day we might be able to encourage the adult human heart to regenerate damaged muscle.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 10?
options: Unlike skin or liver tissue, the adult human heart has limited capacity to replace damaged cells.
During the early development of the heart, the cardiomyocytes divide, allowing the heart muscle to grow.
Although this scar helps maintain the heart’s structural integrity, it cannot contract like healthy muscle.
Myc is a powerful regulator of cell growth and is also associated with cancer when its activity becomes uncontrolled.
questions.explanation: 定位第 10 段，比较四个选项的具体信息。其余选项来自本文其他段落，并非本段明确陈述的内容。
questions.evidence: During the early development of the heart, the cardiomyocytes divide, allowing the heart muscle to grow.

questions.prompt:
Which paragraph contains the following information?
“In a longer experiment, improvements in heart function were still evident 12 weeks after treatment.”
questions.explanation: 这句话位于第 18 段。先找关键词，再核对上下文；正文页显示相同的段落编号。
questions.evidence: In a longer experiment, improvements in heart function were still evident 12 weeks after treatment.

“Encouragingly, no tumours were observed during the reported follow-up of mice receiving the localised treatment.”
questions.explanation: 这句话位于第 23 段。先找关键词，再核对上下文；正文页显示相同的段落编号。
